name: Environment configuration
purpose: Define and apply configuration and secrets for an environment without leaking values.
trigger: A new or changed environment setting is required.
entry_criteria: Environment exists or is being provisioned

steps.note: Secrets go to the secret store; rotation of production secrets needs approval.

failure_paths.condition: Smoke test fails after configuration change
failure_paths.action: Revert the configuration change and investigate

exit_criteria: Configuration is in version control; no secret values in repo, logs or reports
Smoke test passes in the environment
communication_plan: Document changed settings for the on-call team.
